subject: Your FF Digest

disagreements.detail: High expert disagreement: rank 6-20 (std 3.06) -- highest: Mike Harmon (#5), lowest: Nathan Jahnke (#21)

news.title: Keenan Allen traded to 49ers
news.impact: With Mike Evans still sidelined and Deebo Samuel working his way back to practice this week, San Francisco adds depth to its wide receiver room with a veteran in Allen. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar unless both Evans and Samuel continue to miss time.

news.title: Cam Skattebo (hamstring) practices Tuesday
news.impact: Skattebo remains on track to return for Thursday's game against the Commanders. He is expected to be a full-go.

news.title: J.J. McCarthy (hip) practices Tuesday
news.impact: McCarthy remains on track to be good to go for Thursday's game against the Commanders.

news.title: Kirk Cousins identified as prime trade candidate for Vikings
news.impact: Minnesota is expected to make a move for a quarterback ahead of the deadline. This will remain a situation to monitor.

news.title: Tyreek Hill (knee) expected to be medically cleared in a few weeks
news.impact: Hill will be an option for a team that doesn't land a wide receiver ahead of Tuesday's trade deadline.

narrative: The injury report did most of the damage this week. Jayden Daniels (elbow) and C.J. Stroud (concussion) are both ruled OUT, so two starting-caliber quarterbacks just vanished from your lineup options. Bucky Irving (foot) and Matthew Golden (shoulder) are also OUT, while Ollie Gordon II is Questionable with an ankle — keep an eye on that one up to kickoff. Meanwhile, the experts can't agree on Dak Prescott at all: Mike Harmon has him as high as QB5, Nathan Jahnke as low as QB21, with the full range spanning 6 to 20. Start him or sit him, somebody's going to tell you that you were wrong.
